banka.pozadat_fine: The bank looks at what you own and names its terms. You see everything before you agree.
banka.ramec_roste: The credit line grows by {penize:denne} a day and has no ceiling. How much you can borrow is decided by your collateral — the assets you pledge.
banka.splacet_pozdeji: You will start repaying once the chain earns something.
banka.splatit_fine: An early repayment goes to the most expensive loan first. Regular instalments are taken automatically every game month.
jazyk.popis: The whole game switches — messages from the server will come in this language too.
odznak.banker.jak: Lend someone money on the exchange and let the loan run its course — it has to run for at least six game months.
odznak.banker.popis: Lent to another player and got the whole loan back.
odznak.cestovatel.jak: Take the chain across borders — one laundromat in three different countries is enough.
odznak.cestovatel.popis: Has a laundromat built in three countries.
odznak.hvezdy.jak: Take calls and answer politely. Seven days without a break.
odznak.hvezdy.popis: Kept a 4.5 ★ rating for a whole week straight.
odznak.investor.jak: Buy a stake in three different companies and wait for a payout.
odznak.investor.popis: Holds a stake in three different companies and at least one has already paid out.
odznak.krizovka.jak: When a crisis comes, don't stop building — build.
odznak.krizovka.popis: Built a laundromat while an economic crisis was running.
odznak.mrchozrout.jak: Watch the bankruptcy sale — assets of collapsed companies go at a falling price.
odznak.mrchozrout.popis: Bought a laundromat out of bankruptcy.
odznak.naborar.jak: Share your link. Only those who really got started count.
odznak.naborar.popis: Invited three players who actually built a laundromat.
odznak.spojovatel.jak: Pick up the phone yourself. Calls handled by the paid hotline don't count.
odznak.spojovatel.popis: Took fifty calls personally. The operator doesn't count.
